title: Mulch
description: A mod that adds new wood-based blocks for agriculture!
body:
Mulch is a dedicated mod for creating mulch in Minecraft! Throw planks, logs, fences, or even entire chest boats into a wood chipper, and... voila! Wood chips galore! Combine these chips to make mulch and take in the full mulch-y experience.

Credit to [MCreator](https://mcreator.net/) for an easy-to-learn and easy-to-use mod-making system! :D
Join the Discord [here](https://discord.com/invite/ASkVBubyzH) for future updates on my mods!
For more information, visit the [wiki](https://anotherpedia.com/#Mulch%20(Minecraft%20mod))!


The Wood Chipper is a new block used to crush wood into chips. Crafting a Wood Chipper takes a Stone Cutter, Hopper, and four Iron Ingots.
![A wood chipper with its recipe.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cf5564e6627c2038ffccfe2c579a8ff571ccceb1.png)

Throwing wood blocks, such as planks, logs, slabs, stairs, buttons, and other similar items into the Wood Chipper will crush the wood into a pile of Wood Chips.
![A wood chipper with dropped chips.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/831f990216ebefe527f4c9359da9d079f8ae6e2e.png)

Wood Chips can be composted, providing a method to turn wood into bonemeal.
![Wood chips around a full composter.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/32df94dda934cccf388f8f35d35b52ed6b43ace2.png)

Wood Chips can be crafted in a 2x2 square to turn into Mulch. All wood types can be turned into Wood Chips and Mulch. Mulch can also be dyed, giving additional customization. Undyed Mulch can be compressed back into planks when crafted in a 2x2 square.
![A lineup of the mulches.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/163db682b777341080ad8b47249519efcb906e07.png)

Mulch can support flowers, saplings, berry bushes, and crops such as wheat or carrots. Mulch does not require water for crops to grow.
![Flowers and wheat on mulch.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9edecc5186b094b0b7897f2f7dc7c00b1adf1ba4.png)

Crops will have increased growth on Mulch, giving a practical purpose to replace swathes of farmland for more harvests.
![Wheat growing faster on mulch than farmland.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a764f6928345b6b60d3cbb8951d7b7bbf53c72d9.png)
